answer: Proof of Stake protocols resist Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital to earn validator status, where the delta in network influence correlates directly to staked assets. Much like the erratic trajectory of a comet, an attacker attempting to spin up cheap identities faces high capital costs. Effectively, each identity serves as a marble in a weighted voting pool, ensuring that replicating virtual nodes remains economically irrational compared to the yield earned from honest participation.
